items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the labelled theorem `uatowfe` at source lines 957-961: in a univalent universe, if P is a family of contractible types then the dependent product of P is a retract of the fiber of alpha at the identity, hence is contractible, so univalence implies weak function extensionality. The author's proof (source lines 963-973) constructs the retraction explicitly: varphi packages a dependent function as a point of the fiber together with a reflexivity path (lines 966-967), psi evaluates the transported second component pointwise (lines 969-970), and the composite is then identified with the identity by the uniqueness principle for dependent function types (line 972). The conclusion is reached only through the retained corollary that names the map alpha and the fact that contractibility is inherited by retracts. The statement mentions neither the two maps nor the retraction computation.
